thread:
maria: CloudReseller reported Feb GCP payout mismatch for our dedicated SKU. They say payout CSV shows list price, not their committed discount. Can someone triage? :grimacing:
ashok: Please paste the invoice line + partner CSV.
maria: Invoice: INV-2026-02-3301, SKU redwood_dedicated_xs, qty 50, committed net $0.50 (20% off $0.62 list) -> line net $25.00. Partner CSV row: `redwood_dedicated_xs,50,0.62,0.00` they show unit_price_paid=0.62.
james: billing-bot which pricing profile was used for merchant=cloudreseller on 2026-02-28?
billing-bot: export complete for merchant=cloudreseller at 2026-02-28T23:59Z. Pricing profile: PROFILE_PUBLIC_LEGACY.
ashok: That explains it. Merchant has a committed profile (PROFILE_COMMIT_20) but exporter fell back to legacy public. Likely due to SKU alias after the Jan SKU rename.
sophie: I opened GCP ticket GP-88700. GCP says their metering matched the legacy alias and cannot retroactively change processed payouts. They advised updating alias mapping.
maria: Finance asks for dollar delta to request a credit memo. Partner claims $6 shortfall. Can someone confirm?
ames: (typo) james: simple calc: expected partner payout using net 0.50 = 25.00; actual using 0.62 = 31.00 -> partner actually got $6 more. That suggests partner margin assumptions differ. Need partner's payout calc.
maria: Partner clarifies: they expected to receive our net 0.50 plus their 20% margin (0.60 -> $30), but after platform fees they got $24 -> so shortfall $6 vs their $30 expectation.
nashok: OK action: 1) provisional credit memo for $6 to CloudReseller (CM-2026-02-006) 2) engineering to fix exporter mapping and add a regression test.
james: I'll own the exporter fix and PR. Will add an integration test for legacy alias mapping. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
kelly: AP needs invoice id, computed delta, billing export link, and GCP ticket to approve. Maria please attach and route.
maria: Uploaded reconciliation: s3://redwood-billing/gcp/recon/2026-02/cloudreseller-1799601234.csv and export https://internal.redwood/billing/exports/1799601234 (md5:ad0234829205b9033196ba818f7a872b). Routing to Kelly now.
kelly: Approving provisional CM-2026-02-006 for $6 pending final audit. Posting in 2 business days.
sophie: I'll tell partner we issued provisional credit and will follow up when PR merges.
maria: Thanks all. Leaving thread open until CM posts and PR merged.
